verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a formal API Reference (docs-24) which is known to include per-language code snippets, but the evidence pack contains no explicit confirmation of 'runnable' or 'try it' interactive execution, and probes for a discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard paths all returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming runnable/interactive examples, a live OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of the try-it experience.
